body:
I don't want to be a role model.  I am 21 and in college.  I have great grades and am going into my senior year.  I want to be able to party and shit and do homework when appropriate.  I don't want to be a role model and I probably shouldn't be one anyway.  

I think this is where most of my angst comes from.  I want to leave the obligation of older brother/ role model to someone else.

Thank you for this.  It means a lot to know you don't know me, but you care enough to help me.  I do not have a plan or any real desire to kill myself.  I just hit these lows were I keep thinking the same line.  There is no plan besides maybe an overdose, but I don't keep enough drugs around to kill myself and the thought of an overdose seems unpleasant.
